find_and_report_matching: find and report all symbols matching a list of regex patterns and return a count and report
find_matching_symbols: find all symbols in a list that match a given regex pattern and return matching entries
run_symbol_matching: run symbol matching against a list of regex patterns and generate a detailed match report
test_find_matching_symbols: test the find_matching_symbols function with a sample symbol list and regex pattern
refactor_find_and_report_matching: refactor find_and_report_matching to support case-insensitive regex matching and additional symbol attributes
